blocks.zh: 附錄C-E：風險可接受準則、安全資訊披露與國際標準在風險管理中的角色
blocks.en: Annexes C–E: Risk Acceptability Criteria, Safety Information Disclosure, and the Role of International Standards in Risk Management

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解風險政策 → 準則 → 估算 → 評估的完整邏輯鏈，以及三區域風險矩陣的操作方式
blocks.en: Understand the complete logic chain of risk policy → criteria → estimation → evaluation, and how to operate the three-region risk matrix

blocks.zh: 區分「安全資訊（information for safety）」與「殘餘風險披露（disclosure of residual risk）」的本質差異
blocks.en: Distinguish between "information for safety" and "disclosure of residual risk" and understand how they differ in essence

blocks.zh: 說明國際標準如何在風險管理中創造「符合性推定（presumption of conformity）」
blocks.en: Explain how international standards create a "presumption of conformity" in risk management

blocks.zh:
Annex C — 風險可接受性中政策、準則、估算與評估之關係
Relation between the Policy, Criteria for Risk Acceptability, Risk Estimation and Risk Evaluation (p44–p46)
blocks.en:
Annex C: Relation between the Policy, Criteria for Risk Acceptability, Risk Estimation and Risk Evaluation
Relation between the Policy, Criteria for Risk Acceptability, Risk Estimation and Risk Evaluation (p44–p46)

blocks.zh: C.1–C.2 政策框架：從哲學到準則
blocks.en: C.1–C.2 Policy Framework: From Philosophy to Criteria

blocks.zh: 四層邏輯鏈：Annex C 的核心是一條從上到下的邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: A four-level logic chain: the core of Annex C is a chain of logic that runs from top to bottom:

blocks.zh: 政策 → 準則 → 估算 → 評估
blocks.en: Policy → Criteria → Estimation → Evaluation

blocks.zh: 風險政策（Risk Policy）：由最高管理層制定，是「哲學層面」的聲明 — 我們相信什麼程度的風險是可接受的？
blocks.en: Risk policy: set by top management, it is a statement at the "philosophical" level: what level of risk do we believe is acceptable?

blocks.zh: 可接受準則（Criteria）：記錄於風險管理計畫中，將政策轉化為具體的數值或定性要求
blocks.en: Acceptability criteria: documented in the risk management plan, they translate the policy into specific numerical or qualitative requirements

blocks.zh: 風險估算（Estimation）：產出嚴重度 × 發生機率的數字或等級
blocks.en: Risk estimation: produces a number or level for severity × probability of occurrence

blocks.zh: 風險評估（Evaluation）：將估算結果與準則比對，判斷是否可接受
blocks.en: Risk evaluation: compares the estimation result with the criteria to decide whether the risk is acceptable

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務類比
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Analogy

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填製程中，你設定的「無菌保證水準（SAL）≤ 10⁻⁶」、「微粒限度：≥0.5µm <6000/container」、「內毒素限度：<0.25 EU/mL」——這些都是風險可接受準則。
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling process, the "sterility assurance level (SAL) ≤ 10⁻⁶", the "particulate limit: ≥0.5µm <6000/container" and the "endotoxin limit: <0.25 EU/mL" that you set are all risk acceptability criteria.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：直接從藥典抄數字，沒有說明為什麼這個數字對這個產品/製程是合理的。ISO 14971 要求你論證（justify），不只是援引（cite）。
blocks.en: A common mistake is copying numbers straight from the pharmacopoeia without explaining why the number is reasonable for this product/process. ISO 14971 requires you to justify, not merely cite.

blocks.zh: 政策必須考量的因素包括：各上市市場的法規要求、相關國際標準的核准/拒絕限值、現行技術水準（state of the art），以及來自使用者、臨床醫師和主管機關的已確認利害相關者關切。
blocks.en: Factors the policy must consider include the regulatory requirements of each market where the product is placed, the approval/rejection limits in relevant international standards, the state of the art, and the recognized concerns of stakeholders such as users, clinicians and regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: C.3–C.4 三區域模型與 ALARP 原則
blocks.en: C.3–C.4 The Three-Region Model and the ALARP Principle

blocks.zh: 三區域風險矩陣（Figure C.1 概念）
blocks.en: Three-Region Risk Matrix (Figure C.1 concept)

blocks.zh: ISO/TR 24971 建議使用半定量矩陣將殘餘風險分為三個區域：
blocks.en: ISO/TR 24971 recommends using a semi-quantitative matrix to divide residual risk into three regions:

blocks.zh: ALARP 的實務邏輯
blocks.en: The Practical Logic of ALARP

blocks.zh: ALARP（As Low As Reasonably Practicable，合理可行的最低風險）不是「盡力而為」，而是有嚴格的成本效益邏輯：
blocks.en: ALARP (As Low As Reasonably Practicable) does not mean "doing your best"; it follows a strict cost-benefit logic:

blocks.zh: 若進一步降低風險的代價（時間、成本、技術難度）與所獲得的安全收益相比明顯不成比例，則可停止；若代價合理，則必須繼續降低。
blocks.en: If the cost of further reducing the risk (time, expense, technical difficulty) is clearly disproportionate to the safety benefit gained, you may stop; if the cost is reasonable, you must continue reducing the risk.

blocks.zh: 關鍵：你必須記錄推理過程，不能只說「已進行 ALARP 評估」。
blocks.en: Key point: you must document your reasoning; it is not enough to say "an ALARP assessment has been performed".

blocks.zh: 技術可行性 vs 實用性（Practicability vs Practicality）
blocks.en: Technical Feasibility vs Practicality (Practicability vs Practicality)

blocks.zh: 這兩個英文詞的差異很重要：
blocks.en: The difference between these two English words matters:

blocks.zh: Practicable（可行的）：技術上能做到、放入實踐中是可能的
blocks.en: Practicable: technically achievable, possible to put into practice

blocks.zh: Practical（實用的）：方便、好用
blocks.en: Practical: convenient and easy to use

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 問的是「技術可行性」，不是「是否方便」。你不能因為「加這道安全措施太麻煩」就省略它。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 asks about "technical feasibility", not "whether it is convenient". You cannot omit a safety measure because "adding it is too much trouble".

blocks.zh: 經濟可行性的邊界
blocks.en: The Limits of Economic Feasibility

blocks.zh: 「成本太高」本身不能作為接受不必要風險的理由。只有當成本高到會讓設備失去可及性（availability），從而損害公共健康時，才可考量。這個邊界很高，不輕易觸發。
blocks.en: "Too expensive" on its own is not a reason to accept unnecessary risk. Cost may be considered only when it is so high that the device would no longer be available (availability), thereby harming public health. This threshold is high and is not triggered lightly.

blocks.zh: C.5–C.6 四種政策元素對照表
blocks.en: C.5–C.6 Comparison Table of Four Policy Elements

blocks.zh: Table C.1 用四個典型政策元素，展示從政策 → 準則 → 評估的具體操作路徑：
blocks.en: Table C.1 uses four typical policy elements to show the concrete path from policy → criteria → evaluation:

blocks.zh: Table C.1 — Examples: Policy Elements → Criteria → Risk Evaluation (政策元素 → 準則 → 風險評估 對照)
blocks.en: Table C.1 — Examples: Policy Elements → Criteria → Risk Evaluation

blocks.zh:
Annex D — 安全資訊與殘餘風險披露
Information for Safety and Information on Residual Risk (p47–p49)
blocks.en:
Annex D: Information for Safety and Information on Residual Risk
Information for Safety and Information on Residual Risk (p47–p49)

blocks.zh: D.1–D.2 安全資訊：最後一道防線
blocks.en: D.1–D.2 Information for Safety: The Last Line of Defense

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 風險控制優先順序（重要！）
blocks.en: ISO 14971 Order of Priority for Risk Control (Important!)

blocks.zh: 本質安全設計（Inherently safe design）：從設計根源消除危害或降低風險
blocks.en: Inherently safe design: eliminate the hazard or reduce the risk at the design source

blocks.zh: 保護措施（Protective measures）：防護罩、聯鎖裝置、警報系統等
blocks.en: Protective measures: guards, interlocks, alarm systems and so on

blocks.zh: 安全資訊（Information for safety）：警告標示、使用說明、禁忌症等
blocks.en: Information for safety: warning labels, instructions for use, contraindications and so on

blocks.zh: 安全資訊只能在前兩層已充分發揮後才使用。若一個公司將「警告標示」作為主要的風險控制手段，審查時這本身就是一個發現（finding）。
blocks.en: Information for safety may be used only after the first two levels have been fully applied. If a company relies on "warning labels" as its main risk control measure, that in itself is a finding during an audit.

blocks.zh: 三個常見例子
blocks.en: Three Common Examples

blocks.zh: 正確用法："Warning: Do not use haemolyzed serum samples. These can interfere with the measurement and affect the accuracy of the result." — 這是在告訴使用者如何避免特定傷害，屬於安全資訊。
blocks.en: Correct use: "Warning: Do not use haemolyzed serum samples. These can interfere with the measurement and affect the accuracy of the result." This tells the user how to avoid a specific harm, so it counts as information for safety.

blocks.zh: 注意：太多警告標示本身也是一個風險（警告疲勞 / warning fatigue）。如果使用者因為警告太多而分不清哪個重要，這個設計在技術可行性上是有問題的。
blocks.en: Note: too many warning labels are themselves a risk (warning fatigue). If users cannot tell which warning is important because there are too many, the design is problematic in terms of technical feasibility.

blocks.zh: CDMO 關聯：CoA、CoC 與技術文件
blocks.en: CDMO Relevance: CoA, CoC and Technical Documents

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 的角度，向客戶提供的以下文件，部分具有「安全資訊」的性質：
blocks.en: From a CDMO perspective, some of the following documents provided to customers have the nature of "information for safety":

blocks.zh: CoA（分析證書）：記錄檢測結果，讓客戶判斷產品是否符合規格
blocks.en: CoA (Certificate of Analysis): records test results so the customer can judge whether the product meets specification

blocks.zh: CoC（符合性聲明）：聲明製程符合特定標準
blocks.en: CoC (Certificate of Conformance): declares that the process complies with specific standards

blocks.zh: 技術文件（Technical Package）：包含容器密封系統、滅菌確效、無菌保證水準等製程風險資訊
blocks.en: Technical Package: contains process risk information such as the container closure system, sterilization validation and sterility assurance level

blocks.zh: 這些文件中關於已知限制或殘餘風險的披露，是 ISO 14971 框架下「安全資訊」概念的延伸。
blocks.en: The disclosure of known limitations or residual risk in these documents is an extension of the concept of "information for safety" under the ISO 14971 framework.

blocks.zh: 法規觀點：標示錯誤是 FDA 召回主要原因之一
blocks.en: Regulatory View: Labeling Errors Are One of the Main Causes of FDA Recalls

blocks.zh: FDA 每年發布的 Class I/II 召回案例中，標示（labeling）錯誤或遺漏殘餘風險披露是最常見原因之一。「充分披露」的標準是：使用者需要的所有資訊，以安全且有效地使用設備。這個標準在法規審查中的門檻很高。
blocks.en: Among the Class I/II recalls the FDA publishes each year, labeling errors or omitted disclosure of residual risk are among the most common causes. The standard for "adequate disclosure" is: all the information the user needs to use the device safely and effectively. This standard sets a high bar in regulatory review.

blocks.zh: D.3 殘餘風險披露：讓使用者做知情決策
blocks.en: D.3 Disclosure of Residual Risk: Enabling Informed Decisions by Users

blocks.zh: 臨床決策框架中的殘餘風險
blocks.en: Residual Risk in Clinical Decision-Making

blocks.zh: 殘餘風險披露在臨床決策中可能非常重要。以 ICD 為例：植入手術的決定必須在了解「不適當電擊」、「幽靈電擊（phantom shock）感知」等殘餘風險後做出，這些資訊影響患者的生活品質選擇。
blocks.en: Disclosure of residual risk can be very important in clinical decision-making. Take an ICD as an example: the decision to undergo implantation must be made with knowledge of residual risks such as "inappropriate shocks" and "phantom shock" sensations, because this information affects the patient's quality-of-life choices.

blocks.zh: 披露的深度應與殘餘風險的性質和受眾的知識水準相稱（commensurate）——給臨床醫師的資訊可比給一般患者更詳細、更技術性。
blocks.en: The depth of disclosure should be commensurate with the nature of the residual risk and the knowledge level of the audience: information for clinicians can be more detailed and more technical than that for general patients.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：充填製程的殘餘風險披露
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Residual Risk Disclosure for the Filling Process

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性測試（CCI）通過後，仍存在統計性失敗率 → 應在技術文件中披露 AQL 或抽樣計畫的局限性
blocks.en: Even after container closure integrity (CCI) testing is passed, a statistical failure rate remains, so the limitations of the AQL or sampling plan should be disclosed in the technical documents

blocks.zh: 滅菌後的無菌保證水準（SAL 10⁻⁶）是機率性概念，不代表零風險 → 客戶使用說明應包含此說明
blocks.en: The sterility assurance level after sterilization (SAL 10⁻⁶) is a probabilistic concept and does not mean zero risk, so the customer's instructions for use should include this statement

blocks.zh: 生物相容性評估中的殘餘萃取物/溶出物（E&L）風險 → 必要時在 CoA 或技術包中披露已知化學物質的可接受暴露限值評估結果
blocks.en: For residual extractables/leachables (E&L) risk from biocompatibility assessment, disclose where necessary the results of the acceptable exposure limit assessment of known chemical substances in the CoA or technical package

blocks.zh:
Annex E — 國際標準在風險管理中的角色
Role of International Standards in Risk Management (p50–p54)
blocks.en:
Annex E: Role of International Standards in Risk Management
Role of International Standards in Risk Management (p50–p54)

blocks.zh: E.1–E.2 符合性推定與「現行技術水準」
blocks.en: E.1–E.2 Presumption of Conformity and the "State of the Art"

blocks.zh: 符合性推定（Presumption of Conformity）
blocks.en: Presumption of Conformity

blocks.zh: 「協調標準（harmonized standard）」的使用賦予你一個重要的法律效力：如果你符合該標準的所有要求，就推定（presumed）你符合對應的法規基本要求（如 EU MDR Essential Requirements 或 FDA QSR）。
blocks.en: Using a "harmonized standard" gives you an important legal effect: if you meet all the requirements of that standard, you are presumed to meet the corresponding essential regulatory requirements (such as the EU MDR Essential Requirements or the FDA QSR).

blocks.zh: 但這個推定有條件：
blocks.en: But this presumption has conditions:

blocks.zh: 必須符合標準的全部要求，不能只選擇有利的條款
blocks.en: You must meet all the requirements of the standard; you cannot select only the favorable clauses

blocks.zh: 若有相反的證據（不良事件報告、召回），推定不成立
blocks.en: If there is contrary evidence (adverse event reports, recalls), the presumption does not hold

blocks.zh: 偏離標準必須有明確記錄的理由（documented rationale）
blocks.en: Any deviation from the standard must have a clearly documented rationale

blocks.zh: 現行技術水準（State of the Art）的實務意義
blocks.en: The Practical Meaning of State of the Art

blocks.zh: 「現行技術水準」不是靜態的。它由國際標準、最佳實踐技術、已接受的科學研究、主管機關發布文件、以及類似產品的市場資訊共同定義。
blocks.en: The "state of the art" is not static. It is defined jointly by international standards, best-practice technology, accepted scientific research, documents published by regulatory authorities, and market information on similar products.

blocks.zh: 當你偏離一個已建立的標準時，你必須論證為什麼你的替代方案仍符合或超越現行技術水準，而不只是說「我有不同的方法」。
blocks.en: When you deviate from an established standard, you must justify why your alternative still meets or exceeds the state of the art, not merely say "I have a different approach".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在品質系統中引用並遵循 ISO 14971 和 ISO/TR 24971，對法規審查員提供了防禦性依據（defensibility）。若你的無菌充填工廠使用以下標準作為風險管理輸入：
blocks.en: Citing and following ISO 14971 and ISO/TR 24971 in the quality system gives regulatory inspectors a basis of defensibility. Suppose your aseptic filling facility uses the following standards as inputs to risk management:

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1（潔淨室分級）→ 符合即視為控制了微粒風險
blocks.en: ISO 14644-1 (cleanroom classification) → compliance is regarded as having controlled the particulate risk

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1（無菌充填設備）→ 符合即視為控制了無菌操作相關風險
blocks.en: ISO 13408-1 (aseptic processing of health care products) → compliance is regarded as having controlled the risks associated with aseptic operations

blocks.zh: ISO 11135（EO 滅菌）→ 符合即視為控制了滅菌有效性風險
blocks.en: ISO 11135 (EO sterilization) → compliance is regarded as having controlled the risk to sterilization effectiveness

blocks.zh: 這些是 Annex E(a) 場景的直接應用。偏離任何一個，都需要在 RM 文件中記錄理由。
blocks.en: These are direct applications of the Annex E(a) scenario. Any deviation from them requires the rationale to be recorded in the RM file.

blocks.zh: E.3 流程標準與 ISO 14971 的介面管理
blocks.en: E.3 Process Standards and Interface Management with ISO 14971

blocks.zh: IEC 62304 的核心邏輯
blocks.en: The Core Logic of IEC 62304

blocks.zh: 軟體本身是一個特殊的「風險貢獻因素」：它不直接造成危害，但可以透過提供錯誤資訊（如誤導性的劑量計算）間接導致不適當的治療。這正是 IEC 62304 Clause 7 與 ISO 14971 的介面所在。
blocks.en: Software is itself a special "contributing factor to risk": it does not directly cause harm, but it can indirectly lead to inappropriate treatment by providing incorrect information (such as a misleading dose calculation). This is exactly where IEC 62304 Clause 7 interfaces with ISO 14971.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中：充填設備的 PLC 程式、劑量控制演算法、環境監控系統的軟體——都需要評估是否是危害的貢獻因素。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the PLC programs of filling equipment, dose-control algorithms and the software of the environmental monitoring system must all be assessed for whether they are contributing factors to hazards.

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 與 CDMO 的高度相關性
blocks.en: The High Relevance of ISO 10993-1 to CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，ISO 10993-1 最為直接相關，原因：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, ISO 10993-1 is the most directly relevant, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統（西林瓶、塞子、鋁蓋）的材料必須有生物相容性評估
blocks.en: The materials of the container closure system (vials, stoppers, aluminum caps) must have a biocompatibility assessment

blocks.zh: BER 是提交 IND/NDA/MAA 時的必要文件
blocks.en: The BER is a required document when submitting an IND/NDA/MAA

blocks.zh: Annex B 提供了與 ISO 14971 一致的風險方法：
blocks.en: Annex B provides a risk approach consistent with ISO 14971:

blocks.zh: 識別生物危害（hazard identification）
blocks.en: Identifying biological hazards (hazard identification)

blocks.zh: 估算與評估風險（risk estimation and evaluation）
blocks.en: Estimating and evaluating risk (risk estimation and evaluation)

blocks.zh: 控制風險（risk control）
blocks.en: Controlling risk (risk control)

blocks.zh: 監控控制措施效果（monitoring）
blocks.en: Monitoring the effectiveness of controls (monitoring)

blocks.zh: 最終結論記錄在 BER 中，成為 RM 文件的一部分
blocks.en: The final conclusion is recorded in the BER and becomes part of the RM file

blocks.zh: 系統整合思維：三個流程同時運行
blocks.en: Systems Integration Thinking: Three Processes Running at the Same Time

blocks.zh: 在醫療器材開發中，以下三個流程必須同時整合，而不是串聯執行：
blocks.en: In medical device development, the following three processes must be integrated concurrently, not executed in series:

blocks.zh: ISO 14971（風險管理）— 主框架
blocks.en: ISO 14971 (risk management) — the main framework

blocks.zh: IEC 62366-1（可用性工程）— 使用相關危害的輸入和評估
blocks.en: IEC 62366-1 (usability engineering) — input to and evaluation of use-related hazards

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1（生物評估）— 材料相關危害的輸入和評估
blocks.en: ISO 10993-1 (biological evaluation) — input to and evaluation of material-related hazards

blocks.zh: 輸入、輸出和時間節點必須優化協調。常見錯誤：生物評估完成後才做 RM，導致大量補充文件工作。
blocks.en: Inputs, outputs and timing must be optimized and coordinated. A common mistake: doing RM only after the biological evaluation is complete, which results in a large amount of supplementary documentation work.

blocks.zh: Annexes C–E 核心要點總結 / Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Annexes C–E Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Annex C — 風險政策鏈
blocks.en: Annex C: The Risk Policy Chain

blocks.zh: 政策（哲學）→ 準則（計畫）→ 估算（數字）→ 評估（比對）
blocks.en: Policy (philosophy) → criteria (plan) → estimation (numbers) → evaluation (comparison)

blocks.zh: 三區域模型：不可接受 / ALARP / 可忽略
blocks.en: Three-region model: unacceptable / ALARP / negligible

blocks.zh: ALARP：需成本效益論證，不是主觀判斷
blocks.en: ALARP: requires a cost-benefit justification; it is not a subjective judgment

blocks.zh: CDMO：過程規格（SAL、微粒限度）就是風險可接受準則，必須有論證
blocks.en: CDMO: process specifications (SAL, particulate limits) are the risk acceptability criteria and must be justified

blocks.zh: Annex D — 安全資訊雙概念
blocks.en: Annex D: The Two Concepts of Safety Information

blocks.zh: 安全資訊（instructive）= 告訴你怎麼做，是風險控制最後一道防線
blocks.en: Information for safety (instructive) = tells you what to do; the last line of defense in risk control

blocks.zh: 殘餘風險披露（descriptive）= 讓使用者知情後做決策
blocks.en: Disclosure of residual risk (descriptive) = lets users make decisions once informed

blocks.zh: 標示過多本身也是風險（警告疲勞）
blocks.en: Excessive labeling is itself a risk (warning fatigue)

blocks.zh: CDMO：CoA/CoC/技術文件有「安全資訊」性質
blocks.en: CDMO: CoA/CoC/technical documents have the nature of "information for safety"

blocks.zh: Annex E — 標準的法律效力
blocks.en: Annex E: The Legal Effect of Standards

blocks.zh: 協調標準 = 符合即推定符合法規基本要求
blocks.en: Harmonized standard = compliance gives a presumption of conformity with essential regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 標準代表現行技術水準；偏離需記錄理由
blocks.en: Standards represent the state of the art; deviations require a documented rationale

blocks.zh: 三情境：完整標準 / 無接受準則 / 無標準涵蓋
blocks.en: Three scenarios: complete standard / no acceptance criteria / no standard covering the topic
Process standards (62304/62366/10993/14155) must be integrated with ISO 14971
